## Not verifiable from the laptop

- Weight files are not on the laptop. Weight identity rests on the server-side `check` (11 hashes printed and matched before the run) and on every evaluation's summary.json recording the locked hash; it was not re-hashed locally.

- final_eval.log (launcher output) was not recovered; launch order and the absence of retries are inferred from run.json/DONE.json timestamps only.
